correctness.rationale: For k=2,...,8, every periodic admissible rotation necklace is a vertex-disjoint cycle of the order-k golden-mean overlap graph, so every minimum-cardinality unavoidable set is a one-vertex transversal of the c_k necklaces. A deleted subset is unavoidable iff the finite residual directed graph is acyclic; exhaustive product of candidate choices is therefore a rigorous finite classification, with Kahn topological sorting and longest-path DP. Independent enumeration from scratch reproduced candidate counts 2,3,8,25,216,2401,262144; accepted counts 2,1,4,1,40,2,240; and the full path spectra. At k=8 exactly 16 minimizers have residual longest path 15, giving first guaranteed hit length 8+15=23 and avoidance witnesses of length 22. The computation is finite and does not claim an infinite length formula.
residual_risks: The complete finite enumeration is scoped exactly to the stated graph/order range.
